steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
She puts a little money aside every month.

a little + uncountable = a small amount, and that is fine.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
She has a few dinners with friends a year.

a few + countable plural. Same meaning, different kind of noun.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html:
There isn’t much left at the end of the month.

much + uncountable, mostly in negatives and questions.

steps.title: Why is it a little money but a few dinners?
options: because money is more important than dinners
because one is positive and one is negative
because you can count dinners but you cannot count money
steps.answer: because you can count dinners but you cannot count money

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ask about quantity — How much money? How many bills?
say there is a small amount — a little money, a few coins
say there is a large amount — a lot of / lots of
say it is a problem — too much, too many, not enough
choose some or any — I’ve got some, I haven’t got any
talk about money — afford, owe, borrow, debt, rent, refund, save up
